title: Count roles and escalations instead of tiers
action: Slice 5, D6 (store 97ce5225): accounting follows the split — the tier-mix count becomes a role mix plus an escalation share. Sites: status_full/cells.rs:578-600, build.rs:276-288, render.rs:384-405, session_preamble/store.rs:303-328 and budget.rs:765-772, and devtools/statusline.rs:368-372 (the tiered flag). mrs-14 left a NAMED GAP for you: those advice lines still key off tier, so a cell carrying escalate true and NO tier is invisible to them today — the enforcing door already reads the flag, only the advice lags. Close that. PUBLIC CONTRACT, handle deliberately: build.rs:288 emits the tier_mix key in bee status --json. Renaming it is a breaking change for anything parsing that output. Decide — rename, or emit both for a period, or keep the key and change its contents — and justify it on the cap; do not rename it silently because the internals moved. SEPARATE JUDGMENT: verbs/drivers/guard.rs:43 and :101 carry logical_tier inside an object its own comment marks FROZEN. Frozen means a reader depends on the shape. Read that comment and the object's consumers before touching it; leaving it named logical_tier with role-shaped contents may be the honest answer, and if so say why on the cap rather than renaming for tidiness. Sibling cells own the cells verb (mrs-15) and the worker registry (mrs-16) — leave their files alone. Run your verify with --no-fail-fast.

truths: A cell carrying the escalation flag and no tier is visible to every advice line that used to watch ceiling
The mix reported to a human counts roles, and the escalation share is reported beside it
The bee status --json key change is a stated decision on the cap, not a side effect
The frozen logical_tier object is either left alone with a reason or changed with its consumers named
No advice line silently reports zero because its input moved

trace.outcome: The mix counts roles with the escalation share beside it; both advice lines read the flag and count against the feature's cells; tier_mix renamed to role_mix as a stated public-contract decision; logical_tier deliberately left named
deviations: devtools/statusline.rs left untouched: the cell listed it for a `tiered` flag at :368-372, but that flag classifies prompt-cache ephemeral 5m/1h token buckets, not model tiers. The plan inventory misclassified it. No model-tier reference exists in that file.

Reserved 4 paths beyond the cell's list, all consequences of the assigned change: status_full/mod.rs and session_preamble/mod.rs (their private MODEL_TIERS copies became dead and SCARCITY_MIN_TIERED had to become SCARCITY_MIN_CELLS), and status_full/tests.rs and session_preamble/tests.rs (the published-contract probe and the scarcity-wording assertions go red on the rename; updated to pin the new contract, plus 4 new probes).

tier_mix -> role_mix is a clean rename, not a dual-emit. Reasoned at the emit site: no truthful content survives the split, so a retained key would hand every existing field reader a permanent silent zero, where a missing key fails loudly.

logical_tier in drivers/guard.rs left named, per its FROZEN comment. Consumers named at the site: .bee/logs/dispatch.jsonl readers, hooks/model_guard.rs:994 (a second writer of the same key), and verbs/drivers/tests.rs. Only the parameter and the doc comment changed.

Base red NOT mine and NOT fixed: verbs::drivers::tests::a_registration_failure_never_unwinds_the_standing_claim asserts an invalid tier refuses worker registration. Sibling commit 81e7a4b4 opened that enum, so "bogus" is now a legal role and the test is stale. The file is neither in this cell nor reserved by me — it belongs to the cell that landed 81e7a4b4.
